scope.summary: All six change groups only set pointers to NULL after they are freed: in cJSON_Delete, parse_string's fail path, print's success and fail paths, cJSON_PrintBuffered's fail path, and a local parameter in cJSON_free. None of them changes the API, what input is accepted, or anything the caller can observe. The old harness still reaches parse, all three print variants, minify and delete through the same calls. No obligation that would require updating the harness was found.

assessments.reason: cJSON_Delete now sets valuestring and string to NULL after freeing them. The item itself is freed right after, so nothing outside can see the change. The harness calls cJSON_Delete on every successfully parsed tree, so the changed lines run for any string or object-key input.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Changed cleanup: pointers are nulled before the item is freed.
Diff page showing the added NULL assignments.

assessments.reason: parse_string's fail path now sets its local output pointer to NULL after freeing it, and still returns false. The harness reaches this path with an invalid escape sequence after the 4 flag bytes. Parse failure still returns NULL, which the harness handles.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: parse_value sends input starting with a quote to parse_string.
The parse entry calls parse_value and goes to its fail label on error.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Harness parses the input and returns if the result is NULL.

assessments.reason: print() now sets buffer->buffer to NULL after the realloc or copy step. The return value and ownership are unchanged. The harness reaches print() through cJSON_Print and cJSON_PrintUnformatted when the buffered flag is 0.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Unbuffered print calls, then the result is freed.

assessments.reason: print()'s fail path now sets pointers to NULL after freeing them and still returns NULL. The harness already handles a NULL result (line 55). Internal pointer state the contract does not expose is out of scope (D7b), and the entry into print() is exercised.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Harness calls print() and tolerates a NULL result.

assessments.reason: cJSON_PrintBuffered's fail path now sets its local p.buffer to NULL after freeing it and still returns NULL. The harness calls cJSON_PrintBuffered with prebuffer 1 when the buffered flag is set, and handles a NULL result.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Frees the result only if it is non-NULL.

assessments.reason: cJSON_free now assigns NULL to its own by-value parameter, which callers cannot see. The deallocation is unchanged. The harness frees with free() and never calls cJSON_free, so no behavior in the target's scope changes.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The NULL assignment is to a local parameter.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Harness frees with free() and cJSON_Delete, never cJSON_free.

build.reason: fuzzing/CMakeLists.txt builds cjson_read_fuzzer.c into fuzz_main when ENABLE_CJSON_TEST is on, which is the default. Every API the harness calls is still declared with a matching signature, and no change touches build files or declarations. The harness has prototypes and uses C89-style declarations.

evidence.dependency_reason: OSS-Fuzz build.sh delegates to the in-tree script.

input.reason: The harness requires 4 flag bytes and a trailing NUL, then parses data+4 as a NUL-terminated string. cJSON_ParseWithOpts uses strlen, so the trailing NUL keeps reads in bounds. Any JSON the source accepts can follow the flag bytes.

evidence.dependency_reason: Buffer length is taken from strlen.

lifecycle.reason: Each call frees what it creates: the parsed tree is deleted once, the printed string is freed once, and the minify copy is allocated and freed locally. Parse failures return before any print. The changes only add NULL assignments and do not change who owns what.

control_flow.reason: The flag bytes select every route: buffered vs. unbuffered printing, formatted vs. unformatted output, minify on or off, and require_termination on or off. Together these reach every changed function on both valid and invalid inputs.

assumptions: The default global_hooks (not supplied) use the standard malloc/free/realloc. The harness never installs custom hooks, so free(printed_json) matches the allocator, and none of the changes affect this.
fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh was not supplied. It is assumed to compile the harness against the unchanged public API declared in cJSON.h.
